features.name: share_comments_with_actually
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments use the word "actually"?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings. If it is malformed or missing, return null; if the list is empty, return null. Otherwise, for each comment, test case-insensitively with regex r'\bactually\b' (whole word, any position, including inside quotations). Return (number of comments matching)/(total number of comments), a value in [0,1]. Raw text matching; no semantic filtering.

h0: share_comments_with_actually has no association with delta.
h1: Higher share_comments_with_actually is associated with lower likelihood of delta (view change).
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view). Use of "actually" is a literal word match, so quoted text, other senses (non-corrective use) and the corrective intent are not distinguished. The share is a row-level proportion of comments, and comments are unordered and may include several from one commenter. Comment text may contain outcome announcements or later-reply content; raw matching does not exclude them. Association only, not causal.
